title: Ctbp1 and Zeb1 share a thalamic polarity and vesicle-trafficking response distinct from Zeb2
exact_observed_result: Ctbp1 and Zeb1 both induced a 151 TH Stxbp2/Ap1m2/F11r trafficking cassette; Zeb1 also induced PATJ/SPINT2/CDC42BPG in 151 TH and 155 MB Glut, whereas Zeb2 showed its strongest corrected response in 052 Pvalb GABA with Rasd2, Gramd1b, and Plcl1 up and Tm6sf1 down.
biological_interpretation: Mature neurons reuse a restricted CTBP1-ZEB1 polarity/trafficking branch, but ZEB1, ZEB2, and canonical SMAD/TGFbeta perturbations are not interchangeable in this assay.

evidence_records.statistics: 202 perturbed cells versus 23679 controls; Ctbp1 logFC -0.383, score -3.85, p=1.17e-4, FDR=0.128; Stxbp2 logFC 1.02 FDR=4.87e-19; St3gal4 logFC 0.587 FDR=1.01e-6; F11r logFC 0.754 FDR=4.78e-4; Mal2 logFC 0.557 FDR=4.78e-4; Ap1m2 logFC 2.93 FDR=0.0256; Hook2, Arap2, and Usp43 each FDR=0.0957.
evidence_records.description: The only Ctbp1 perturbation with more than one gene at FDR<0.05, dominated by up-regulated trafficking and junction-associated genes.

evidence_records.statistics: Zeb1 transcript was measured in 23 Zeb1-perturbed cell types; all had FDR=1.0. Nominal p values ranged from 0.0163 to 0.978; logFC ranged from -0.479 to 0.392.
evidence_records.description: The measured Zeb1 mRNA did not show multiple-testing-significant depletion in any cell type.

evidence_records.statistics: 173 perturbed cells versus 23679 controls; 15 genes FDR<0.05. Stxbp2 logFC 1.220 FDR 3.97e-25; Ap1m2 logFC 4.347 FDR 1.24e-20; F11r logFC 1.122 FDR 1.49e-10; Cdc42bpg logFC 4.488 FDR 3.52e-08; Patj logFC 0.357 FDR 6.81e-06; Spint2 logFC 2.283 FDR 2.18e-04.
evidence_records.description: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut carried the largest Zeb1 downstream signature.

evidence_records.statistics: 163 perturbed cells versus 20353 controls; 5 genes FDR<0.05. Ap1m2 logFC 2.883 FDR 6.09e-11; Cdkn2d logFC 0.975 FDR 0.00146; Spint2 logFC 1.445 FDR 0.00150; Stxbp2 logFC 1.133 FDR 0.0180; Patj logFC 0.459 FDR 0.0213.
evidence_records.description: 155 MB Glut had a smaller Zeb1-induced module overlapping the 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut response.

evidence_records.statistics: Stxbp2 was FDR<0.05 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, logFC 1.220 FDR 3.97e-25; 191 MB P MY GABA, logFC 1.573 FDR 8.82e-05; 145 MH-LH TH Glut, logFC 1.310 FDR 0.0112; and 155 MB Glut, logFC 1.133 FDR 0.0180.
evidence_records.description: Stxbp2 was the only measured gene recurring at FDR<0.05 in four Zeb1-responsive cell types.

evidence_records.statistics: 19 of 23 Zeb1 cell-type contrasts had zero FDR<0.05 genes. High-count examples with no significant genes were 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut, 114 perturbed versus 15039 controls, min FDR 1.0; 052 Pvalb Gaba, 114 versus 13710, min FDR 0.578; and 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, 77 versus 10110, min FDR 0.580.
evidence_records.description: Most profiled cell classes showed no multiple-testing-significant Zeb1 response.

evidence_records.statistics: Zeb2 transcript was measured in 22 Zeb2-targeted signatures; 0/22 had Zeb2 pvals_adj<0.05 and 3/22 had nominal p<0.05. Strongest measured knockdown: 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut logFC -0.408, p=0.00149, FDR=0.895; 052 Pvalb Gaba logFC -0.172, p=0.0351, FDR=1.0; 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut logFC -0.121, p=0.430, FDR=1.0.
evidence_records.description: Measured on-target transcript change for Zeb2 itself shows weak captured target engagement.

evidence_records.statistics: 112 perturbed cells versus 13710 controls; 4 genes at FDR<0.05, 11 at FDR<0.10, and 34 at p<0.001. Rasd2 logFC 1.754 FDR 3.17e-6; Gramd1b 0.415 FDR 3.91e-5; Plcl1 1.015 FDR 0.00726; Tm6sf1 -0.375 FDR 0.0399; Dlx6 -0.887 p=2.41e-5 FDR 0.0799; Patj 0.966 p=5.01e-5 FDR 0.0827.
evidence_records.description: The clearest Zeb2-assigned downstream signature occurs in Pvalb GABAergic neurons.

evidence_records.statistics: Across all Zeb2 signatures, only 2/22 cell types had any FDR<0.05 gene; 20/22 had none. Examples with adequate cell numbers but no FDR<0.05 gene were 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 186 perturbed cells and 4 genes at p<0.001; 155 MB Glut, 170 perturbed cells and 2 genes at p<0.001; and 059 CNU-LGE LSX GABA, 74 perturbed cells and 0 genes at p<0.001. The smallest Zeb2 group was 217 P MY Pineal Glut, with 27 perturbed cells and 0 FDR<0.05 genes.
evidence_records.description: Most Zeb2-assigned guide groups produced little downstream differential expression.

evidence_records.statistics: Across 2045 non-Zeb1 signatures in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Ctbp1 was the top positive Pearson neighbor of Zeb1 with r=0.103; the strongest negative neighbor was Camta1 with r=-0.070. Ctbp1 perturbation had 202 perturbed cells and 5 FDR<0.05 genes, including Stxbp2 logFC 1.021 FDR 4.87e-19, F11r logFC 0.754 FDR 4.78e-04, and Ap1m2 logFC 2.928 FDR 0.0256.
evidence_records.description: Ctbp1 perturbation partially converged with the Zeb1 response in the dominant responsive cell type.

evidence_records.statistics: Zeb1 perturbation had 173 cells and 15 FDR<0.05 genes: Stxbp2 logFC 1.220 FDR 3.97e-25, Ap1m2 4.347 FDR 1.24e-20, F11r 1.122 FDR 1.49e-10, Patj 0.357 FDR 6.81e-6. Ctbp1 perturbation had 202 cells and 5 FDR<0.05 genes: Stxbp2 1.021 FDR 4.87e-19, St3gal4 0.587 FDR 1.01e-6, F11r 0.754 FDR 4.78e-4.
evidence_records.description: A Zeb1/Ctbp1-associated thalamic module is strong in the same broad dataset but is not produced by Zeb2.

evidence_records.statistics: Restricted to the top 200 Zeb2 genes by absolute Wilcoxon score: in 052 Pvalb Gaba, score correlations were Zeb1 0.113, Ctbp1 0.095, Smad2 0.096, Smad3 0.117, Smad4 0.061. In 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut, correlations were Zeb1 0.264, Ctbp1 0.170, Smad2 0.105, Smad3 -0.007, Smad4 -0.055. Using the top 200 Zeb1 genes in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Zeb1-Ctbp1 score correlation was 0.455 whereas Zeb1-Zeb2 was 0.134.
evidence_records.description: Restricted-signature correlations separate the Zeb2 Pvalb/L4 responses from Zeb1, Ctbp1, and SMAD perturbations.

caveats: Zeb1 and Zeb2 self-transcript knockdown was not FDR-significant, so guide assignment, not captured ZEB mRNA depletion, anchors the downstream signatures.

prior_expectation.summary: Prior literature and pathway context were taken from the resolved report references; the observed Perturb-seq signal either refines expected gene function by cell type or marks an exploratory response-state neighbor where noted in caveats.
